operations.name: evaluate_frame
operations.signature: fn evaluate_frame<'a>(view: SceneView<'a>, time_seconds: f64, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<EvaluatedFrame<'a>>; fn update_animation_clips(frame: &mut EvaluatedFrame<'_>, shape: ShapeId, update_bounds: bool, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<()>
operations.implementation: evaluate_frame evaluates current accepted DocumentView overlays and publishes changed tables; per-overlay clip refresh uses seeded SceneView IDs and atomic replace_clips. update_animation_clips is implemented. No full native FlatKernel render adapter is in this crate.
operations.contract: Uses accepted r2 APIs: all-record shape/transform/clip IDs and scene_id; effective frame references; owner-before-suffix matrices; instance-specific ancestry; current overlay order; atomic whole clip replacement. Exact renderer/provider composition is a later adapter. Unsupported values preserve explicit diagnostics.
